subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After repairing both persistence races, should OpenClaw permanently expose the opt-in maintenance timeout key and the generic synchronous command-queue timeout callback?
rationale: The correctness defects have a narrow mechanical repair, but accepting a new operator setting and a shared queue ordering API is a lasting product/API choice that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Narrow the contracts
options.body: Reuse existing timeout policy and keep the timeout/fence lifecycle private to context-engine maintenance where practical.

options.title: Accept both contracts
options.body: Keep the public key and generic callback with explicit owner approval, upgrade documentation, and focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle redesign
options.body: Pause the PR if safe release requires a broader cancellation and persistence ownership model.

recommendation.title: Narrow the contracts
recommendation.body: Reuse existing timeout policy and keep the timeout/fence lifecycle private to context-engine maintenance where practical.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main history most directly connects this person to all three central lifecycle paths.
